description: Runs the open-source hefesto-ai engine (`hefesto analyze --no-config`, free tier) on the files you send to the hosted analyzer and returns its findings: rule id, severity, file, line, message and the SARIF hefestoFingerprint/v1 fingerprint (format "sarif" adds the full SARIF 2.1.0 log). Provide files, or a single code snippet plus language. Covers Python, COBOL, the DevOps/IaC formats hefesto analyze routes, and TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust and C# through the multilang tree-sitter grammars (the first such request on a fresh server instance downloads the grammars and can take a few seconds longer). Limits: 20 files, 100 KB per file, 256 KB in total, 20 seconds, 10 requests per minute per IP, shared across server instances. No .hefesto.yaml is read. Files are deleted after the run; nothing is stored. For a whole repository, run `hefesto analyze .` locally.

inputSchema.description: Provide files, or code (language optional, default python). severity and format are optional.

code.description: A single snippet, used only when files is omitted (written as e.g. snippet.py for language python). At most 100 KB.

files.description: Files to analyze. Used instead of code when present. path: relative POSIX, at most 200 characters and 8 levels; each segment is letters, digits, "_", "." or "-" and must not start with "-"; no "..", no absolute paths, no ".git" or ".hefesto.yaml". content: UTF-8 text, no NUL bytes, at most 100 KB.

content.description: UTF-8 source text. At most 100 KB. No NUL bytes.

format.description: json (default): findings only; sarif: also the full SARIF 2.1.0 log.

language.description: Language of code when files is omitted. Default python. Ignored when files is set. An unknown language is rejected; send files instead.

name: analyze

outputSchema.description: ok true carries the hosted analyzer body in analysis. ok false carries error and message. On success the content text is the summary and the analyzer JSON. On failure the content text is the error sentence only.

analysis.description: Analyzer JSON. The content text is a one-line summary plus this object.

error.description: Failure code when ok is false. invalid_json when the analyzer body was not JSON.

message.description: Same string as content[0].text when ok is false.

ok.description: true when the engine returned analyzed: true.

title: Analyze code
